name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response was "Hola" (hello in Spanish). I followed the quickstart's OpenAI SDK approach: installed openai, set the base_url to https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1, used the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable, and called client.chat.completions.create().
deviations: The quickstart specifies model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", which returned a 404 Not Found error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I had to change the model to "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash" (a currently available model I discovered via the models.list() endpoint) to get a successful response. All other code and configuration matched the quickstart exactly.
